title: The Fisherman and His Wife
summary: A poor fisherman catches a magical animal that gives him a very nice new house.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, an old man and his wife lived in a small house near the sea.

The fish looked at the man and asked him to set it free back into the sea.
The kind man did not want to hurt the animal, so he let it go without any trouble.
When he returned home, he told his wife about the wonderful fish he had seen.
His wife became very angry and asked why he had not taken anything from the special creature.
She wanted a better house because their old one was small and poor.
The man went back to the sea and called for the fish, which appeared above the water.
The fish listened to the man and gave them a nice new house immediately.
However, the woman was still not happy after a few days passed.
She wanted more power and asked her husband to make her a ruler.
The man went back to the water again and asked the fish for another big change.
The special animal made her a ruler, but the woman wanted even more control over the whole world.
She finally asked to become like a god, which made the fish very angry.
When the husband returned to the sea to ask for this final wish, the weather turned bad.
The water became dark and wild as the fish took away all their new things.
The man and his wife were left back in their small, poor house once again.
Many years passed while the couple lived in that small house near the water.
Sometimes they thought about the special fish and the strange events that had happened.
The old man always remembered how the fish had spoken to him in the afternoon.
His wife often wished that she had been more patient with their simple life.
If she had kept her happiness, they would have stayed in the nice new house forever.
Instead, her great desire for power led to complete ruin and sadness.
The local people who heard the story often talked about the very difficult woman.
They agreed that people should always be glad for what they already possess.
Extreme desire only brings trouble, while a calm heart brings true joy.
Life by the sea went on quietly for the old man and his faithful wife.
Every morning, the man walked down to the shore to look at the blue waves.
He never saw the special fish again, but he often thought about that afternoon.
His wife learned a hard lesson about wanting too much power and control.
She spent her days working around the small house and helping her husband.
They did not need any more big changes or fancy things to be happy.
Their simple home was enough for them as they lived out their remaining years.
Whenever the wind blew hard over the water, they remembered the storm.
That terrible day stayed in their minds as a warning against boundless desire.
The man and woman stayed in their home and worked every single day.
They ate simple food and drank clean water from the nearby well.
The sun rose and set over the water while the seasons changed slowly.
They talked about the past and remembered the lessons they had learned.
The woman understood that her strong drive had destroyed their bright future.
She smiled at her husband because she finally appreciated his company.
They shared stories with people who visited the small local town.
Everyone agreed that simple lives were better than lives built on extreme demands.
The old couple found peace in each other during their final years together.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, an old man and his faithful wife inhabited a modest dwelling situated right near the restless sea.
Every single day, the man walked down the rocky shore to cast his net into the deep water in search of fish.
The salt air filled his lungs while the endless horizon offered a quiet comfort to his aging mind.
He had lived this simple existence for decades, accepting whatever fortune the tide decided to bring him.
Little did he know that one particular afternoon would shatter the quiet routine of their unremarkable lives forever.
During that fateful afternoon, the man felt a heavy tug upon his net and pulled with all his remaining strength.
To his utter astonishment, he hauled up a very strange fish that possessed the uncanny ability to speak like a human being.
The creature looked directly into the old man's weathered eyes and begged to be set free back into the safety of the sea.
Being a gentle soul, the kind man had no desire to harm any living creature, especially one so miraculous.
Without hesitation, he released the captive fish back into the water, watching it vanish beneath the dark waves without any trouble whatsoever.
When the fisherman finally returned home to his cramped cottage, he eagerly told his wife about the wonderful fish he had encountered.
Instead of sharing his wonder, his wife became fiercely angry and demanded to know why he had not asked the creature for a reward.
She pointed out their miserable, decaying walls and argued that they deserved a far better house than this wretched hut.
Though he felt reluctant to ask for favors, the man yielded to her persistent nagging and walked back down to the shore.
He called out to the enchanted fish, which promptly appeared above the surface of the water to hear his request.
The obligating fish listened carefully to the man's embarrassed plea and granted them a charming new house immediately.
Upon his return, the old man found his wife standing before a sturdy cottage complete with a lovely garden and a warm hearth.
For a brief period, contentment seemed to settle over the couple as they enjoyed their upgraded surroundings and comfortable furniture.
However, after only a few days had passed, the woman's ambition began to fester like an untreated wound.
She realized that a mere house was not enough to satisfy her growing hunger, so she decided to aim much higher.
Driven by an insatiable thirst for power, the woman commanded her husband to return to the shore and demand that the fish make her a ruler.
Reluctantly, the weary man walked back to the water, where the waves had turned a sullen gray to match his heavy heart.
He whispered his wife's grand demand to the receptive creature, and the magical animal fulfilled the wish without uttering a single word of complaint.
When the husband returned, he discovered his wife seated upon a magnificent throne while local officials bowed before her commands.
Yet this elevation only fueled her arrogance, for control over a single region could never appease her boundless appetite.
Not content with ruling a kingdom, the ambitious woman decided she must control the entire world and everything within it.
She sent her husband back to the shore once more, instructing the reluctant messenger to demand that she be granted the status of a supreme deity.
As the old man delivered this final, outrageous demand, the previously calm ocean swelled with sudden and violent fury.
The water grew pitch dark and wild as the majestic fish listened to the arrogant request with profound displeasure.
Without granting the wish, the creature vanished into the depths, leaving the terrified man standing alone in the howling wind.
When the husband hurried back to find his home, the magnificent palace and the royal throne had completely vanished into thin air.
Instead of luxury, he found his wife waiting outside the exact same small, poor house where their journey had originally begun.
The harsh weather mirrored their ruined fortunes, and the cold reality of their greed settled heavily upon their shoulders.
Many long years passed while the humbled couple continued to live in that very same modest dwelling near the water.
Sometimes they looked out at the churning waves and reflected upon the strange events that had disrupted their quiet lives.
The old man frequently remembered how the miraculous fish had spoken to him with such human sorrow on that afternoon.
His wife often wept as she wished she had possessed the wisdom to appreciate their simple life of quiet contentment.
Had she maintained her initial happiness, they certainly would have retained the comfortable new house for the rest of their days.
Instead, her relentless drive for absolute control had led them directly to complete ruin and profound emotional sadness.
The local villagers who heard whispers of the strange tale often shook their heads when discussing the exceptionally difficult woman.
Everyone in the surrounding area agreed that human beings should always remain grateful for whatever blessings they already possess.
They understood that extreme desire inevitably invites trouble, whereas a calm and accepting heart brings genuine joy.
Life by the sea eventually resumed its quiet rhythm for the old man and his now faithful, reflective wife.
Every morning, the man walked down to the shore just to observe the endless rolling of the blue waves.
Although he never encountered the special fish again, the memory of that encounter remained vivid in his mind.
His wife learned a painful lesson about the dangerous consequences of wanting too much power over the world.
She spent her remaining days sweeping the floors of the small house and helping her husband with his daily chores.
They realized they did not need grand titles or expensive possessions to find peace within their hearts.
Their simple home proved entirely sufficient as they navigated the final chapters of their shared existence.
Whenever a strong gale blew across the water, they paused to remember the terrifying storm that had cured their greed.
Working side by side every single day, the couple found a deep, enduring comfort in their mutual companionship.
They ate plain food from their pantry and drank fresh water drawn directly from the stone well outside.
The sun continued its predictable journey across the sky, rising and setting while the seasons shifted with gentle grace.
By sharing stories with occasional visitors, the old woman openly admitted that her own ambition had destroyed their bright future.
She would smile warmly at her husband, finally recognizing that true wealth is found only in love and quiet acceptance.
